marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & Semiconductor Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech enterprise earnings reports confirm continued elevated capital expenditure targeting AI hardware infrastructure, driving strong forward revenue guidance for leading GPU and chip equipment vendors.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capex expansion provides valuation support for US semiconductor supply chain leaders, maintaining positive momentum across the broad US technology sector.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential supply chain bottleneck constraints and high baseline valuations vulnerable to any sudden shifts in US Treasury yield trajectories.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet Sector & Southbound Capital
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index experienced sustained net inflows via the Southbound Stock Connect, led by increased positioning in major e-commerce and digital gaming platforms following solid preliminary Q2 operational metrics.
marketLayer.inference: Continuous retail and institutional capital inflows from mainland investors are providing a liquidity buffer for high-weight HK tech constituents, capping downside price pressures.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of mainland Chinese retail consumption recovery and potential price-war competition among leading consumer platforms.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Global Liquidity Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Cooling labor market indicators in the US have increased market probability pricing for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts later this year, causing a pullback in the US Dollar Index and 10-year Treasury yields.
marketLayer.inference: Easing yield pressures improve global risk asset appetite, benefiting capital-intensive Hong Kong equities and high-dividend yield sectors via lower cost of capital expectations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of sticky core service inflation readings delaying the actual execution or scale of upcoming monetary easing.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles (NEVs) & HK-Listed Auto Stocks
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV manufacturers published strong mid-month delivery volumes alongside announced expansion plans into European and Southeast Asian distribution channels.
marketLayer.inference: Export channel growth helps offset domestic margin pressure caused by domestic price adjustments, sustaining long-term top-line revenue growth narrative for tier-one manufacturers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Increasing overseas trade barriers, tariff policy adjustments, and competitive pricing actions within domestic markets.
